latency_ms.scope: Serial case wall time including public context preparation, uploads, actual tools and validation; not just inference.

source_snapshot_support.scope: Exact saved snapshot statistics/event text matched to original public records. This does not check how a generated answer uses the snapshot; it is not answer-claim entailment.

citation_semantic_support.scope: Small purposive agent visual/source review of explicitly selected claims after inference. Not representative, not private-label accuracy and not pooled with numeric-statistic checks.

private_label_evaluation: Unavailable until a separate offline evaluator reads external private labels after frozen results. No labels are loaded by this runner.
browser_verification: Blocked: supported browser access host unavailable; no navigation/mobile/keyboard interaction pass
hardware_verification: Physical microphone/speaker unverified; recorded-file ASR/TTS are separate
availability_warning: Corpus has no independent availability clock for all records. Same-time availability assumptions disclosed; closure content fenced at closed_at; lab analysis excluded.

manual_semantic_sample.scope: Small purposive agent visual/source review of explicitly selected claims after inference. Not representative, not private-label accuracy and not pooled with numeric-statistic checks.

memory.scope: Recorded per-case sampler bounds apply; Windows fallback measures harness working set only. P0 had no psutil and is explicitly unmeasured; Ollama/VRAM/whole-system peaks not inferred.

suggested_contract_validation: jsonschema absent; projection provides required fields/statuses, full schema validation unverified
